title: Fix digestFunction in grpc remote downloader

timeline.body:
I'm new to java and this repo. I didn't know how to update BUILD file and run format. And no development doc.

Can someone tell me how to do it?
Formatting is done with https://github.com/google/google-java-format. There is no automation for BUILD file maintenance such as Gazelle.

timeline.message:
Fix digestFunction in grpc remote downloader

fix https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/22863

timeline.body: Out of curiosity, why would we permit this to be null?

reply.body:
GrpcCacheClient implement RemoteCacheClient. For RemoteCacheClient, digestFunction could be null.

This is my first time to write java. Please point out my problems if I understand it incorrectly.
